description: This file defines the SocialMediaAuthenticationController class within the OrangeHRM OpenID Authentication plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and overrides the preRender method to set up a component for social media authentication interfaces.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationController
classes.description: Controller managing social media authentication UI components, extending AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Method invoked before rendering the view, initializes and sets a Vue component named 'auth-provider-list' for social media authentication options.
